svg.title: OSDU Delivery: Container diagram for OSDU Delivery
svg.desc: Every container and what it reaches; a source file enters at the bottom left and leaves as an OSDU record on the right.
svg.text: Every container and what it reaches; a source file enters at the bottom left and leaves as an OSDU record on the right.

g.title: Pipeline developer: Writes the estate's flows, mappings, templates, schedules, assertions and AI contexts in VS Code, checks and previews them against the synced estate, and pushes them to the estate repository.

Data operator: Triggers and watches runs, follows a record from its source file and row to the OSDU id and version it landed as, releases, redelivers or removes records, reads assertion reports and asks the assistant.
Administrator: Registers and describes OSDU partitions, sets the central configuration every run resolves with, approves AI contexts, manages users and sets retention on the Maintenance page.

AI coding assistants: An assistant a person runs (Claude Code, the VS Code chat, Cursor, Codex). It calls the MCP server with the person's own token, so it can do what that person can do, and what it does is recorded as theirs.

VS Code extension: Makes the editor the place a pipeline is developed: the GUI's pages in tabs, completion and checks for every flow, mapping and template, a mapping's preview from the open file, and one sign-in it shares with the command line and the MCP server.
g.text: GUI pages in the editor; checks

g.title: Workbench GUI: SQLFlow's workbench with the module's pages registered through the GUI module contract: pipelines and runs, lineage, the ledger and its records, the explorer of what OSDU holds, assertions, dimensions, inventories, templates, caches and the chat assistant. A static single-page app served by nginx; it calls the control plane's API.

MCP server: osdu-delivery-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server: SQLFlow's server composed with the delivery module. Every assistant reads its instructions; it answers from metadata, and from data only for a ! question through a read-only query over what an approved AI context opens. It holds no credential: it forwards each caller's token.

sqlflow CLI: The sqlflow command line (SqlFlow.Delivery.Cli.Host): every SQLFlow verb plus the OSDU verbs (check, preview, values, records, config, partition, cache, template and more). It checks and previews the working copy, drives the control plane, and can run a flow locally through the same executors a node uses.

Control plane: SQLFlow's control plane (.NET 9) with DeliveryControlPlaneModule: the REST API (the delivery API under /api/v1/delivery), identity and tokens, the managed git sync, schedules, the run queue and dispatcher, the node protocol, the chat assistant, and the module's background services. It decides what runs and owns the state; it runs no flow itself.

AI model provider: The chat model behind the GUI assistant and Explain: a Foundry deployment (gpt-5.1 in the shipped environments), or OpenAI or Anthropic by setting, plus an optional transcription deployment for voice. Off on a fresh deployment; no flow, mapping, render or delivery ever calls a model.

Estate repository: The estate as YAML and JSON files in git: flows, mappings, templates, cache definitions, schedules, assertions and AI contexts. A run executes the commit the control plane last synced, never a working copy.

Compute node: SqlFlow.Delivery.Worker.Host: SQLFlow's worker with the module installed. It takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it can sit next to the data, and reads and writes the ledger in the osdu schema through the catalog's connection.
g.text: Pulls runs; executes the file, ing

g.title: Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.

OSDU data platform: A data partition's core services (Storage, Search, Schema, Legal, File, Dataset, Workflow, Entitlements) and its domain data management services (Wellbore, Reservoir over ETP, Production), which hold the delivered records and their bulk data.
Source systems: Where the data starts. Upstream applications and jobs drop files (CSV, JSON, Parquet, LAS and others) into the landing storage, or hold the data in a database a flow reads.

Landing storage: A storage account with a hierarchical namespace and shared keys off, container landing. Every run is given its location as LANDING_URL (abfss://landing@<account>.dfs.core.windows.net): the source files the file flows land, the bulk payload files deliveries send, and work batch files when a flow writes them there.
g.text: Source files, bulk files to send,

g.title: Ingestion database: OsduData: the pre tables a file flow lands its files into, the keyed ingestion tables an ing flow upserts (stamping UpdatedDate_DW) and a delivery flow reads incrementally, and the tables dimension flows build. Snapshot isolation must be on.
